title: Tenant data-locality policy suggester and automated evidence synthesizer
creator: Aisha R. Patel
description:
Problem: Customers operating under regional compliance regimes (finance, health, government) need a low-friction way to assert where tenant data can be stored and to produce audit-ready evidence that the Hosted API honored those restraints. Existing flows require manual pin selection and ad-hoc evidence pulls, which is error-prone for large tenant fleets.

Proposal: Build a "policy suggester" that analyzes tenant traffic patterns and metadata to recommend a defensible data-locality profile (region pinset + retention presets). Pair this with an "evidence synthesizer" that can compile attestable bundles per tenant (signed manifest, route traces, retention config snapshots, and sample payload redaction log) on demand or on a schedule. The UI should allow dry-run enforcement and a canary rollout for hard pins. The backend provides API endpoints for enforcement and a signed ZIP evidence format for compliance teams.

Key design points:
- Suggestion heuristics: geolocation of request originating IPs, declared tenant legal jurisdiction, configured data sources, PII detection signals, and historical zone residency. We will expose the confidence score and reasoning for each suggested pin.
- Retention presets: map tenant types to suggested retention windows (e.g., SaaS SMB: 30d, Healthcare: 90d immutable logs) with ability to customize per-tenant. Presets stored as named profiles.
- Evidence synth: compact bundle containing manifest.json (policy id, timestamp, signer), routing trace CSV, retention-config snapshot, sample request hashes (not payloads), and KMS-signed attestation. Bundle generated on-demand via Console or the Admin API and retained for N days based on plan.
- Enforcement modes: Soft-suggest (UI only), Soft-enforce (log + telemetry, still allow cross-region), Hard-enforce (reject cross-region writes). Provide dry-run toggles and automated rollback when errors or spikes occur.
- Integration points: Console (policy suggester wizard), Hosted API routing layer (enforcement hooks), Audit store (evidence artifacts), KMS for signatures, and RBAC checks for bundle access.

Why this is different: Instead of only offering manual pin controls, the suggester reduces operator overhead and surfaces defensible rationale that legal teams can review. The synthesizer standardizes evidence packaging for audits and legal requests, reducing time-to-respond and manual collection errors.
acceptance_criteria: Console: a policy-suggester wizard is available in the Tenant > Residency tab that shows a suggested pinset and confidence score
API: /admin/tenants/{id}/residency-suggestion returns suggestion payload and confidence reasons
Evidence: Admin UI and API can generate a signed evidence bundle that includes manifest, routing trace, retention snapshot, and signed attestation
Enforcement: ability to toggle Soft-suggest, Soft-enforce (log-only), and Hard-enforce with dry-run capability
Telemetry: dashboard shows suggestion uptake rate, enforcement errors, and evidence bundle generation counts
Security: evidence bundles are encrypted in transit and signed by KMS and access is RBAC restricted
tasks: Finalize heuristics RFC with Research/Applied ML and Legal

Storage: evidence archive retention policy and storage quota checks
E2E tests: dry-run flows, error handling, and signing verification
Release: feature flag gated rollout and canary cohort plan
